title: Ohm's Law Current Calculator
description: Set a supply voltage and a series resistor, and read the LED current before you power a real circuit.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Chapter 16: Physical Computing and Electrical Safety Basics

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a supply voltage and a resistor value, the learner calculates the resulting current and judges whether it is safe for the connected LED.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Two sliders with a live circuit diagram and a colour-coded safety verdict
pedagogical.assessment: Give a supply and resistor pair and ask for the current and whether it is safe.
